summary: refactor(settings): move pair-reasons from fxa-shared to fxa-settings
description:
Because:

- Only fxa-settings uses PAIR_GLEAN_REASONS, but the file lives in fxa-shared.
- FXA-12722 moves folders out of fxa-shared.

This commit:

- Moves pair-reasons.ts to packages/fxa-settings/src/lib/glean/.
- Points the 4 fxa-settings importers at the relative path.
- Replaces the false fxa-content-server comment with one line.
- Changes the path text in the reason description in fxa-ui-metrics.yaml.
- Adds pair-reasons.test.ts for isPairGleanReason.

Closes FXA-10664
